L154-177 header -> GlassPanel root (testID scheduled-exports-panel) with title (text-lg semibold) + subtitle (text-sm secondary) and the primary New-schedule Button (glyph '+', testID scheduled-exports-new-button, onPress startCreate).

L179-330 form (testID scheduled-exports-form, gated on showForm) -> a single-column fields stack (web grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 resolves mobile-first to one column): Name (FieldInput), Cron expression (FieldInput + help), Export type (Select), Format (Select), Range window (FieldInput + help), Delivery kind (Select), and the conditional Delivery target (FieldInput + help, shown only when delivery.kind!=='download', email/url placeholder + keyboard) — each wrapped in a LabeledField (uppercase label span + control + optional help span). Form actions: Cancel (ghost, closeForm) + Save schedule (primary, loading create.isPending||update.isPending, testID scheduled-exports-form-submit).
L332-347 loading/empty branches -> three pulsing Skeleton bars while isLoading, else EmptyState (title + message) when rows.length===0. The web 'no-action' comment is preserved.

L348-443 table (testID scheduled-exports-table) -> each row is a native card (testID scheduled-exports-row-{id}, opacity-50 when !enabled): name as the card title, then labelled RowFields Type ('{export_type} ({format})'), Cron (mono schedule_cron), Delivery ('{kind}' + ' → {target}' when target set), Next run (TimeStamp or '—'), Last run (TimeStamp or 'Never'), Status (success/danger Badge or '—'), then the actions row: Run now (ghost, loading runNow.isPending && runNow.variables===row.id, testID scheduled-exports-run-{id}), Disable/Enable (ghost, toggleEnabled), Edit (ghost, startEdit), Delete (danger, setPendingDelete, testID scheduled-exports-delete-{id}). The web table column headers name/type/cron/delivery/nextRun/lastRun/status/actions (L353-360) are preserved: type/cron/delivery/nextRun/lastRun/status become the per-field labels, name is the card title, and actions is the button row.
